$comment: Hard npm-tarball budgets. Required public docs, editor/CEM data, declarations, runtime, compatibility metadata, and generated references remain shipped. Re-measured on 2026-09-17 ON the @aceshooting/lyra-ui@18.0.0 release commit: 8,315,035 packed bytes, 33,786,130 unpacked bytes, 3,549 files. Measure on the release commit, never before the version bump -- the bump adds the release's CHANGELOG section (a shipped file) and the new version/release history in package-metadata.ts, so a pre-bump measurement is always short. The approved exception still fails closed above this exact reviewed ceiling.

baselineExceptionReview.reason: Re-measured ON the 18.0.0 release commit, not before it. `changeset version` writes the release's own CHANGELOG section into packages/lyra-ui/CHANGELOG.md, which package.json#files ships, so any budget measured on the pre-bump tree under-counts by that whole section plus the new version string and release history embedded in package-metadata.ts. That is what took packed to 8,315,035 bytes against a ceiling of 8,313,694 re-baselined only hours earlier, and it is the same shape as the component-quality staleness one gate over. The 18.0.0 content itself is lr-filter-bar chip filters, lr-map's interactive legend and lr-virtual-list's light-DOM row projection, plus the shared-slice move that put legendTypeShown/legendTypeHidden into every locale's shared slice. Drift headroom is unchanged at 34,000 packed / 140,000 unpacked (0.41% each).
